# dokku_ssh_key (Data Source)

Manages an SSH public key for git push access via dokku's ssh-keys plugin

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_ssh_key" "example" {
  name = "deploy-bot"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name that identifies the key in dokku

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
- `key` (String) Public key contents (required)
